target_customer: B2B SaaS companies with customer success teams
problem: Customer success managers lacked data to predict churn and prioritize accounts across large books.

founders.name: Craig Soules
education: PhD in computer science (institution not named on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: CS PhD focused on storage, databases and distributed systems; later founded Springtail.

technical_complexity.rationale: Predictive churn analytics over customer data needs integration and modeling work; the founder's data systems PhD fit the problem.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with customer data created some stickiness but the category drew Gainsight, Totango and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it directly; Freshworks, an existing customer, acquired Natero in May 2019 and rebranded it Freshsuccess.

market_need_then: Subscription software was growing and customer success emerged as a function around 2012, creating demand for churn tools.

rebrands.why: Absorbed into Freshworks after the acquisition; reason inferred, not stated by a company source.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding searches only returned results about Natera, a different company; no brand evidence for Natero was found.

outcome_analysis: Natero raised about 3.3 million dollars in total, largely funding growth from revenue per its founder, and sold to its customer Freshworks in May 2019 after seven years. It stayed a small independent player next to larger customer success vendors, and the exit folded it into Freshworks as Freshsuccess.
